category_title: Students who disengage and exhibit behavioral issues when curriculum lacks challenge and teacher communication is perceived as indirect
scenario_title: Reviewing previously learned, unchallenging material for test prep
minimal_context: The tutor and student are reviewing previously learned math concepts during the first 30 minutes of class to prepare for the MSA standardized test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our MSA test prep. For the next thirty minutes, we are going to review the math concepts you were taught in your previous math courses.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are we doing this? You just go over the same old stuff. The way you teach is so boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to review these concepts for the standardized test. Please look at the first problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's not interesting. You're just playing with words. You don't put any style or pizzazz into it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just focus and try to get through this review worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Man, I know this! It's easy! I don't want to listen to her. I just don't feel challenged in here, so I don't care.

task.content: Reviewing mathematical concepts taught to students in previous math courses to prepare them for the state-administered standardized test, the Maryland School Assessment (MSA)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher goes over the same old stuff that the student already knows
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Verbally expresses that the work is too easy and disengages from the lesson
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feels the class is not challenging and thinks 'I don't want to listen to her'
related_quotes: Man, I know this! It's easy!
I don't want to listen to her.

behavior_patterns.condition: When lessons are perceived as boring and unchallenging
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Becomes uninterested in what is being taught and develops an 'I don't care' attitude
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Believes the teacher doesn't put any style or pizzazz into the teaching
related_quotes: The way she teaches is so boring. It's not interesting. She's playing with words. She doesn't put any style or pizzazz into it.
